summary.text: Roger Hauck is a Republican state senator from Michigan who represents District 34 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; he advanced from the August 4 Republican primary.
He previously served in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2017 to 2023, and his career experience includes co-owning a building company.

paragraphs.text: Roger Hauck's career experience includes co-owning a building company.
He has served as a trustee of Union Township and has been affiliated with the National Rifle Association, the Michigan Farm Bureau and Mt. Pleasant Sacred Heart.
Hauck represented District 99 in the Michigan House of Representatives from 2017 to 2023, and he took office in the state Senate for District 34 on January 1, 2023.
In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Energy and Environment and Health Policy and Human Services committees and served as minority vice chair of the Senate Regulatory Reform Committee.
In the August 4, 2026 Republican primary he defeated Rhonda Lange, and in the general election he faces Democrat Tyler Landgraf.
